hook: Nothing you do is ever lost.

segments.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
segments.en: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.

segments.ar: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
segments.en: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,

segments.ar: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
segments.en: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
